text: Given a Duo Admin API integration's ikey/skey/host and an account with administrator activity in the last 30 days, When duo_logs_administrator_logs is called with mintime covering that window, Then the response is valid JSON containing at least one administrator-action log entry
steps: Obtain a real Duo Admin API integration key/secret key/host with the Grant read log information permission
Start the duo-mcp server locally (uv run duo-mcp)
Send an MCP tools/call for duo_logs_administrator_logs with X-Duo-Ikey/X-Duo-Skey/X-Duo-Api-Host headers and mintime set to 30 days ago
expect: Valid JSON array/object of administrator-action log entries, not an error envelope
notes: needs a real vendor account; per mcp-track.md section 2.5/3 this does not block shipping

text: Given the same account has zero administrator activity in a narrow time window, When duo_logs_administrator_logs is called with that window, Then the response is valid JSON representing an empty result, not an error
